title: Agent Memory Inspector — Audit What Your Agent Remembers
tagline: Microsoft Foundry just shipped editable agent memory to production. Paste an agent's memory store (procedural / user / session scopes) and get an instant hygiene report — expired TTLs, contradictions, scope leaks, candidate PII, duplicates — plus a retrieval simulation showing which memories a query would actually recall. 100% in your browser, no API key.
description: Agent-memory hygiene checks (expired TTLs, contradictions, scope leaks, PII) plus a poisoned-recall simulation.
